segments.sn22.20:1.3: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn22.20:1.4: Anattasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ kuto attā bhavissati!
segments.sn22.20:1.5: Vedanā anattā … saññā anattā … saṅkhārā anattā … viññāṇaṃ anattā.
segments.sn22.20:1.9: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn22.20:1.10: Anattasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto attā bhavissati!
segments.sn22.20:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
